knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Slow flow and a large surface area relative to volume let organisms settle and form biofilm. The other options are wrong or unrelated.
Valves limit back-flow from the mouth. Removing them or treating them as a substitute for flushing defeats their purpose.
Reporting is the cleaner's role. Using an expired kit, improvising a test or removing a line are all outside the role.

practicalCriteria: Given a mock chair with a missing valve, the learner identifies the fault and names the person to report it to.
The learner explains why a product is not dosed by an untrained person.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written fault report from the mock exercise
stopWorkCriteria: A leak is spreading water to electrical equipment
A cleaner is asked to dose or connect a water treatment product without training
